title: Medina — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Medina: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Medina has a population of 1,488,000. The second holiest city in Islam, home to the Prophet’s Mosque and a major destination for religious tourism. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 307 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.

Last updated: November 07, 2026
